Fixes battery status text wrapping in narrow landscape layouts.

- Paired panels stack when their available container width is too narrow.
- Battery status words such as Discharging stay intact.
- Very narrow screens place battery-health icons above their labels and values.

Browser-verified at widths of 320, 390, 667, 740, 780, 844, 1024 and 1440 pixels, with no horizontal overflow. All 20 frontend tests pass locally; release automation repeats the frontend tests and both Home Assistant regression suites before publishing.

Install **v1.19.3b5** through HACS with beta versions enabled, restart Home Assistant and refresh the frontend. The existing AlphaESS (Beta) dashboard picks up the new layout automatically. No dashboard recreation, separate card download or YAML change is needed.

Only layout styles and release/documentation metadata changed from v1.19.3b4. Sensor values, history, controls and inverter behaviour are unchanged. All previous beta features remain, including corrected flow direction, PV1/PV2 visibility and automatic idle PV3/PV4 hiding.

**v1.19.2 remains the stable release.**
